purpose: Graph-of-Mark relation review for PSD-to-UIIR outputs.
inputs: graph_overlay.png with candidate ids and graph edges
rules: Use only supplied graph node ids and candidate ids.
Confirm or reject existing graph evidence with relation_patches instead of regenerating the UI tree.
Use component_group_patches when existing candidates together form one runtime UI component.
Do not propose direct bbox edits to existing candidates or UIIR nodes.
Return missing_region_proposals only for visible UI regions absent from the graph; the program will quarantine these records for review.
Use render_diff_notes for visual discrepancies between the reference and replay render.
Return JSON matching the strict structured output contract.

relation_patches.edge_id: string, empty when no exact graph edge is being reviewed

component_group_patches.type: Button, Input, Toggle, Slider, Container, List, Grid, ScrollView, or Unknown
